note: L* = issue-style localization built from real fixes merged after 2026-07-01 (after the model's training data). The code at HEAD already has the fix; the question asks where the behavior lives. C* = impact questions. Each key is a list of groups; a group is satisfied when any of its regexes matches. Score = satisfied groups / groups.

questions.q: Bug report: a StatefulSet named web adopts or treats as its own a pod named web-01, as if it were ordinal 1. Pod names with a leading zero in the ordinal should not count as members of the set. Which file and function(s) decide whether a pod belongs to a StatefulSet?
Bug report: the Job controller metric job_pods_creation_total counts a failed pod create as both failed and succeeded. Where is this counted? Give the file and function.
Bug report: the taint-based pod eviction latency histogram has almost every sample in the +Inf bucket, and some values are negative. Where is that latency recorded? Give the file and function.

Bug report: the node authorizer's graph keeps or drops edges wrongly when the same pod or persistent volume is added more than once, because reference counts are off. Which file holds that graph, and which functions add pods and PVs to it?

Bug report: kube-proxy decides whether NodePort services should be reachable on localhost by guessing from the configured node port address CIDRs. Where is that loopback decision made? Give the file and function.

Bug report: kube-controller-manager memory grows slowly in clusters with node churn; the node lifecycle controller keeps health data for nodes that were deleted. Where is that per-node health data stored and cleaned up? Give the file and function.

Bug report: kubectl describe node prints -9223372036854775808% for every pod in the Non-terminated Pods table when the node has not reported allocatable yet. Which file and function compute those per-pod percentages?

Bug report: a LimitRange max or limit/request ratio is bypassed when a container sets a huge limit such as 2^63+1; the value wraps and reads as within bounds. Where are these LimitRange checks? Give the file and the functions.

Bug report: during preemption the scheduler treats a PodDisruptionBudget with an empty selector as matching nothing, so victims covered by it are not counted as PDB violations. Where are victims filtered by PDB violation? Give the file and function.

Bug report: a topology spread constraint whose labelSelector is empty but not nil is ignored by the scheduler instead of matching all pods. Where does the scheduler count matching pods for spread constraints? Give the file and function.

Bug report: after a Service is deleted and recreated with the same name, the EndpointSlice controller sometimes skips syncing and the slices stay out of date. Which files track which EndpointSlices the controller expects, and decide whether to sync?

Bug report: after a container restarts, liveness and readiness probes start right away because the new container is reported as started before its own startup probe has passed. Where does the kubelet carry the Started value over from the previous status? Give the file and function.

Security report: the iSCSI volume plugin builds directory paths from user-controlled volume fields, so a crafted value can escape the plugin directory. Which files build and use those plugin directory paths?

Bug report: the client-go metric for exec credential plugin policy calls is never registered, even when a caller passes it in the registration options. Where are client-go metrics registered? Give the file and function.
Bug report: an informer resync error says "couldn't queue object: %!w(<nil>)" and the real cause is lost. Which file and function produce this error?

Bug report: the kubelet's sysctl allowlist admission treats a pod without hostUsers set as if it were in a user namespace, so it admits or rejects the wrong sysctls. Which files decide this? Give files and functions.

Bug report: with the static CPU manager, full-pcpus-only and distribute-across-NUMA enabled, container admission hangs forever under the CPU manager lock on nodes with fragmented free CPUs. Where is the loop that hangs? Give the file and function.

Bug report: after a pod finishes, the ResourceClaim controller removes the pod from the claim's reservedFor list, then adds it back later, so the claim is never released. Which file and functions decide whether a pod needs claim work?
If I change the formula in the topology manager's UtilizationScore function, which non-test files outside the topologymanager package change behavior? List every calling file.
Which non-test files call the scheduler helper GetPodGroupStates? List every calling file.
Which non-test kubelet files call the status manager's ClearPodResizePendingCondition, and with which resolution values? List every calling file.
In the scheduler, which in-tree plugin implements the PlacementFeasible extension point, and which file runs that extension point for a pod group?
